verdicts.human_summary: When the branch ref file doesn't exist (packed refs), watchFile() returns undefined and no branch watcher is installed, causing git state changes to be missed. Suggests adding a fallback watcher on refs/heads directory.
verdicts.reasoning: The closest AI comment is AI Comment 2, which suggests watching parent directories instead of individual files, but for a completely different reason: inotify on Linux tracks inodes rather than paths, so atomic renames cause watchers to go silent. The human comment identifies a distinct failure mode where the ref file doesn't exist at all (packed refs), so no watcher is ever created. No AI comment addresses the scenario of a missing ref file or the need for a fallback watcher when the loose ref doesn't exist yet.
